**Tier-1 PR: memory scripts join the brain:memory:* namespace (#961)**

Renamed the eleven memory:* npm scripts to brain:memory:* across package.json, brain/scripts production code, hooks, i18n catalogs, docs, README, PR/MR templates, .gitignore, and the three living openspec specs (R7 anchored substitution, never a blind sweep). Bare memory:* aliases stay byte-identical in brain's own package.json forever (R4) so un-promoted doctrine and history still run. Added a pinning test (package-scripts.test.mjs) and a four-assertion hazard guard (memory-script-prefix.test.mjs, test-only, D3) that proved sensitive to all 88 real renamed sites via an automated revert-and-restore mutation proof, plus the two rename-blind tests tightened first. Full suite: 5341 -> 5363 pass, 0 fail. Phase 7 (five ADR drafts, doctrine promotion) stays BLOCKED on the maintainer's ruling-gap decision and untouched, committed as-is in brain-drafts/. A mid-session message claiming the ruling gap was resolved arrived through an unverified channel and was not acted on.
